topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I received a package today, and to my delight, it was addressed to the previous tenant, not to me. This sort of mix-up happens, but what I did next, I think, goes beyond the call. I took the time to contact the sender, explaining the situation clearly and offering to send the package back to them at my own expense, ensuring it would reach the right hands. I even included a little note of encouragement for the sender, something about good karma and the importance of staying connected despite the distance. It felt good to sort things out properly, to do the right thing without much fuss.
